title: patch_file fails to apply pure-insertion diffs (no removed lines) on large files
description: 4 patch_file attempts using only context+addition lines failed against .moeb/README.md (49.9KB). A remove-and-restore workaround was required, which introduced an unintended blank-line deletion. This pattern will recur whenever an agent needs to insert into a large file without deleting existing content.
proposed_resolution: Fix the patch_file apply logic to correctly handle hunks with no removed lines. Add a regression test with a large file and a pure-insertion hunk.
